measured_on: last frame of A, first frame of B
method: dominant-gradient direction of the luminance channel, quantised to 16 sectors
breaks_first_on: a carry through a camera move that swings past the key
honest_limit: Measures where light appears to come from in the frame. A scene genuinely lit from two sides has no dominant direction and the measure is meaningless there.

measured_on: last frame of A, first frame of B
method: mean colour temperature and mean luminance, both in thousandths of their declared range
breaks_first_on: a reframe across a long chain, where drift accumulates below the per-link threshold
honest_limit: Cumulative drift is the failure this measure is worst at. Each link passes and the twentieth frame is a different afternoon.

measured_on: last frame of A, first frame of B
method: dominant colour of the subject-region mask, CIEDE2000
breaks_first_on: any seam longer than two nodes from the anchor
honest_limit: Requires a subject mask. Where segmentation fails the pin reports a pass it did not earn, which is the worst failure mode a pin can have.

measured_on: last frame of A, first frame of B
method: apparent field of view from vanishing-point spacing; background blur radius
breaks_first_on: a reframe, which is allowed to change framing but not glass
honest_limit: Estimating focal length from a single frame is weak. Stated as a ratio between the two sides rather than an absolute
column9: because the comparison is more reliable than either measurement.

measured_on: last frame of A, first frame of B
method: subject bounding-box height as a fraction of frame height
breaks_first_on: OTS and other relational framings, where two figures must hold their relative positions
honest_limit: Not applicable across a REFRAME by construction — a reframe that could not change subject scale would be a carry.

measured_on: last frame of A, first frame of B
method: line-segment histogram over the non-subject region, earth-mover distance
breaks_first_on: a carry through a truck or orbit, where the built world must rotate coherently
honest_limit: The measure cannot distinguish a world that rearranged from a camera that moved further than declared. It detects that something is wrong, not which.

measured_on: last frame of A, first frame of B
method: face or character embedding distance, engine-declared model
breaks_first_on: a hold across three or more nodes — identity drift is the signature failure of long generative chains
honest_limit: GENERATIVE-SPECIFIC. No prior era needed this pin, because no prior era could lose an actor between two frames of one take. The embedding model must be named in the seam, because a distance is meaningless without it.

measured_on: last frame of A, first frame of B
method: noise-power spectrum slope, and the three-point luma curve
breaks_first_on: a HOLD where the seed was reseeded rather than continued
honest_limit: GENERATIVE-SPECIFIC. Photochemical grain was stochastic and unaddressable; generated grain has a seed, so it can change mid-take and must be pinned when it must not.

measured_on: last frame of A, first frame of B
method: the invariant named in the seam — one of shape-mask-IoU, motion-vector-angle, or dominant-hue
breaks_first_on: a MATCH seam whose author had an idea rather than a measurement
honest_limit: Only meaningful for the MATCH class, where it is mandatory. The tolerance is deliberately loose: a match cut is a perceptual effect, and a tight numeric threshold would refuse cuts that work.
